name: Taira no Masakado
source: [spoiler]Taira no Masakado's soul, corrupted into a wraith. Akiyasu intends to use him in the Ritual of Lord Taizan, hoping his deceased father will be resurrected in exchange for the sacrifice of the protagonist to Masakado.[/spoiler]
